admission_invariant: No event or label may be selected, derived, or QA-approved unless every required source, rights, receipt, event-time, denominator, independence, missingness, and rebuildability gate is true.
executable_handoff: Select one candidate event and pin an authoritative UTC event anchor before examining post-event outcomes.
Receipt the exact EAGLE-I parent files and license, then provide deterministic transform and event-join code for the selected county set.
Pin an event-time customer denominator and document how changing utility coverage and zero-versus-gap ambiguity are handled without imputation.
Acquire only bounded VNP46A2 exports after approved Earth Engine authentication; record collection, dates, bands, quality mask, task IDs, sizes, and byte checksums outside Git raw/cache paths.
Re-run the deterministic gate; create labels only if every required gate becomes true.
